changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to single 'Protein Sequence Generation' as it's the main focus. Removed redundant model 'Progen2' (duplicate of 'ProGen2'). Removed dataset descriptions that were not proper dataset names but rather filtering criteria. Normalized 'Uniprot' to standard 'UniProt'.
Consolidated Pfam variants to base 'Pfam' metric. Removed descriptive phrases that are not metric names but rather implementation details. Kept only the core metric names used for evaluation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in this paper. The paper focuses on protein language models and biological safety evaluation, not natural language evaluation using LLMs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were automated using biological and computational metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on protein language models and biological sequence generation rather than traditional natural language generation. The evaluation metrics are biological (BLAST, MMseqs2, Pfam, etc.) rather than linguistic. The extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant items and implementation details that were removed for clarity. The paper is primarily about safety-constrained protein generation using knowledge graphs and preference optimization.
